'''Norman Perion''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 California State Championship]] on 5 May 2001 with EBO (ANSB), according to Michael Mendoza's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2281">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-10-ca-championship-5-5-01d2281/ ca-championship-5-5-01], DeckTech (Michael "Longshot" Mendoza, 10 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-10-ca-championship-5-5-01d2281/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
